name: The Amazing World of Gumball
description: The life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year old cat who attends middle school in Elmore. Accompanied by his pet, adoptive brother, and best friend Darwin Watterson, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with various family members: Anais, Richard, and Nicole Watterson, and other various citizens.

videos.title: Early Reel
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin attempts to break out of school by getting launched.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Cool To Be Felt
videos.overview: Darwin and Gumball feel each other and talks about how they feel.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Pineapple
videos.overview: Gumball thinks he is allergic to himself and accidentally sneezes his mouth onto a pineapple.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Infinite Loop
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin become their hand puppets' hand puppets.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Weird Food
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin come across a bowl of weird purple food while walking around.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: BirdPlaneBird
videos.overview: Darwin tries to share his drink with BirdPlaneBird.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Gnomes
videos.overview: Darwin imagines a gnome while Gumball tries to imagine something else.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Insulting Voices
videos.overview: Gumball makes Darwin mad because of his puppet's voice so Darwin gives Gumball the taste of his own medicine.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Beards
videos.overview: Darwin accidentally imagines a beard on himself so Gumball helps.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Grump
videos.overview: Howdy, Grady, and Frank organise a party for Gumball and Darwin.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Spoons
videos.overview: Grady lost his precious spoon.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Telly
videos.overview: Grady and Howdy want to make a TV show, but they cannot figure out what type of TV show they should make.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Cleaning Up
videos.overview: Grady wants his friends to help him clean the house.

videos.title: Waiting for Gumball: Bored
videos.overview: Frank is bored so he annoy his friends until they help him be entertained.

videos.title: The DVD
videos.overview: An overdue DVD causes chaos (and a hefty fee) for Gumball and Darwin.

videos.title: The Responsible
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin get to babysit Anais whilst their parents go to a PTA meeting but being "responsible" has a different meaning when you don't know what it means.

videos.title: The Third
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin grow bored of one another and seek out a third friend to make their lives more exciting.

videos.title: The Debt
videos.overview: Believing that his life had been saved, Gumball vows to repay his debt by saving Mr. Robinson's life.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin, thinking that the world will end in 24 hours, decide to make the most out of their remaining time.

videos.title: The Dress
videos.overview: When his clothes are shrunk in the washing machine by his father, Gumball is forced to wear his mother's wedding dress to school.

videos.title: The Quest
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin help Anais get her beloved doll back after it is lost on the way to school.

videos.title: The Spoon
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin become unwitting accomplices in a stick-up at a gas station.

videos.title: The Pressure
videos.overview: When Masami claims that Darwin is her boyfriend, Gumball vows to help his friend before he gets kissed.

videos.title: The Painting
videos.overview: After seeing a picture that Anais drew, Principal Brown assumes that Anais finds her family dysfunctional, so he begins to meddle in their family life.

videos.title: The Laziest
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin challenge their father to a laziness competition, with the loser having to do the winner's chores.

videos.title: The Ghost
videos.overview: When a ghost named Carrie possesses Gumball's body in order to feel earthly experiences and to eat, he must learn to say "no" to her.

videos.title: The Mystery
videos.overview: Gumball decides to investigate when his class finds Principal Brown wrapped up in toilet paper, shaved and, covered in green paint, or else face detention.

videos.title: The Prank
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin's pranks on their father get out of hand.

videos.title: The Gi
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin are ridiculed for their martial-arts outfits by their schoolmates, and their mom tries to convince them to take them off.

videos.title: The Kiss
videos.overview: A kiss from Grandma JoJo traumatizes Gumball, and Darwin attempts to help him forget.

videos.title: The Party
videos.overview: Gumball and his friends are invited to a high-school party hosted by Tobias's sister Rachel, but they must find dates in order to attend.

videos.title: The Refund
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin go to great lengths to get their money back from an incompatible video game, but the rental store's policy prevents them from getting it.

videos.title: The Robot
videos.overview: Gumball decides to help Bobert act like a real boy. However, it soon becomes a battle for his very identity when the robot plots to take over his life.

videos.title: The Picnic
videos.overview: A school picnic in the Forest of Doom poses a hazard for Gumball and Darwin.

videos.title: The Goons
videos.overview: Gumball competes in a race in order to win Dad back.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Gumball tries desperately to find out Darwin's secret.

videos.title: The Sock
videos.overview: Mr. Small teaches Gumball and Darwin various ways of becoming more honest.

videos.title: The Genius
videos.overview: Darwin goes to an institute for geniuses.

videos.title: The Poltergeist
videos.overview: Richard believes there's a ghost in the attic but is actually Mr. Robinson who Gumball moved up there after entering a catatonic state due to being kicked out by his wife. Gumball and Darwin work on trying to restore Mr. Robinson whilst Richard, unaware of this, sets traps for the ghost.

videos.title: The Mustache
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin want to become adults, Richard wants to lose weight. After accidentally having their cereal switched with supplements Richard ordered, Gumball, Darwin and Anais find themselves having very unusual growth spurts.

videos.title: The Date
videos.overview: Gumball learns how to date, so he can go out on a date with Penny. Later on it turns out that he is going to a funeral, not a date.

videos.title: The Club
videos.overview: When Gumball turns down an offer to join the Rejects Club, they seek to enact revenge against him.

videos.title: The Wand
videos.overview: The guys share the power of magic with Dad.

videos.title: The Ape
videos.overview: Ms. Simian cozies up to Gumball in order to win an award.

videos.title: The Car
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin are eager enough to do numerous chores at Mr. Robinson's house, until they accidentally destroy his car.

videos.title: The Curse
videos.overview: Gumball's good day turns bad to worse throughout his school day, much to the point where he believes he is "cursed".

videos.title: The Microwave
videos.overview: Gumball creates a creature, made of every gross thing he could find, with a cannibalistic appetite.

videos.title: The Meddler
videos.overview: Seeing Gumball in need of attention, Nicole hangs out with him at school, which becomes increasingly embarrassing for her son.

videos.title: The Helmet
videos.overview: Gumball wears a lucky helmet, but it tears his family apart.

videos.title: The Fight
videos.overview: After Gumball's bullying problem, Tina Rex demands to have a fight with him.

videos.title: The Remote
videos.overview: The Watterson family fights over the remote when they realize everything they want to watch comes on at the same time.

videos.title: The Colossus
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin upset a giant.

videos.title: The Knights
videos.overview: Gumball and Tobias compete for Penny's affection by putting on the lamest duel in history.

videos.title: The Fridge
videos.overview: Mom tries to inspire Gumball to develop ambition.

videos.title: The Flower
videos.overview: Gumball is jealous when he sees Leslie with Penny.

videos.title: The Banana
videos.overview: Gumball seeks justice when Banana Joe chews Darwin's pen.

videos.title: The Phone
videos.overview: Darwin develops a texting addiction when he and Gumball get their first cell phone.

videos.title: The Job
videos.overview: Richard gets a job as a pizza delivery man, which worries Nicole when strange things begin to occur around the neighborhood.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Gumball, Darwin and Anais go to a haunted-house party.

videos.title: The Treasure
videos.overview: Anais hunts for hidden treasure after uncovering a secret.

videos.title: The Apology
videos.overview: Miss Simian owes Gumball an apology.

videos.title: The Words
videos.overview: Darwin tries to be more direct with Gumball as his teacher.

videos.title: The Skull
videos.overview: The guys befriend a compulsive liar.

videos.title: The Bet
videos.overview: Bobert becomes Gumball's servant and obeys every command he receives.

videos.title: Christmas
videos.overview: Santa Claus is coming to town. Unfortunately he gets run over by the Wattersons, so it's up to them to save Christmas.

videos.title: The Watch
videos.overview: The guys try to retrieve a family heirloom from an old man.

videos.title: The Bumpkin
videos.overview: Gumball envies rural life and asks Idaho to teach his family to live like potatoes.

videos.title: The Flakers
videos.overview: Darwin abandons Gumball when faced with a beating by Tina, so Gumball plots revenge.

videos.title: The Authority
videos.overview: After Richard is hospitalized from an accident, Granny JoJo is overprotective and puts the family in danger, which leads Nicole to disagree with her parenting style.

videos.title: The Virus
videos.overview: An evil virus seeks vengeance on Gumball, Darwin, and Teri after they wipe out his army of bacteria.

videos.title: The Pony
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin rent a film to watch with Anais, but they keep getting distracted on their way home.

videos.title: The Hero
videos.overview: Richard gets upset when he realizes Gumball and Darwin think of him as a laughing stock.

videos.title: The Dream
videos.overview: Darwin kisses Penny in one of Gumball's dreams and he gets mad about it.

videos.title: The Sidekick
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin try to get a game back from Tobias, but Darwin begins to feel like he is just a sidekick to Gumball.

videos.title: The Photo
videos.overview: Gumball tries to look good in the school photos.

videos.title: The Tag
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin get caught in the middle of a trash can feud between Richard and Mr. Robinson.

videos.title: The Storm
videos.overview: A plot to improve Alan and Carmen's relationship backfires, and Gumball has to reunite them.

videos.title: The Lesson
videos.overview: The guys have detention and try to escape; Granny JoJo is overprotective and puts the family in danger.

videos.title: The Game
videos.overview: The Wattersons play Dodge or Dare (Dodj or Daar).

videos.title: The Limit
videos.overview: Mom lets the Wattersons have it in a supermarket.

videos.title: The Voice
videos.overview: When Gumball and Darwin receive a scary email, everyone is a suspect...

videos.title: The Promise
videos.overview: Darwin has promised to play video games with Gumball, but there is a Banana Joe-shaped problem...

videos.title: The Castle
videos.overview: When Nicole is away "anything goes" and Richard's lack of rules soon attracts unwelcome house guests.

videos.title: The Boombox
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin try to understand Juke's urgent beatbox message.

videos.title: The Tape
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin fail to make instant home movie classics.

videos.title: The Sweaters
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin's reputation is challenged and they really couldn't care less...

videos.title: The Internet
videos.overview: Gumball decides to take down the Internet after he accidentally creates an embarrasing viral web video.

videos.title: The Plan
videos.overview: The Watterson kids come up with a fool-proof plan to save Nicole, but is it Gumball-proof?

videos.title: The World
videos.overview: The life of the "inanimate" objects of Elmore are shown in a series of short skits.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: The Wattersons are surprised to discover that their past actions have consequences.

videos.title: The Kids
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin's voices may be breaking, but they're showing no signs of growing up. Whilst Gumball and Darwin make fun of Mom and Dad for being old, their voices start to break. They try to ignore it, but everybody they meet reacts to their new and unpredictable voices.

videos.title: The Fan
videos.overview: New Elmore Junior High student Sarah becomes Gumball and Darwin's obsessive number-one fan.

videos.title: The Coach
videos.overview: The new coach at Elmore High stands up to Jamie. The new Coach witnesses Jamie bullying the other kids at lunch and steps in. Jamie is made to apologize, much to the amazement of the other kids. Gumball and Darwin worry about Jamie seeking revenge, especially when they see her sneaking into the back of Coach's car.

videos.title: The Joy
videos.overview: When Miss Simian sees Gumball and Darwin joyful on Monday, she knows that something is wrong with them. She performs tests on them, but the nurse disapproves what she's doing. But suddenly, Gumball and Darwin start to infect the school with the 'Joy Virus', and it's up to Miss Simian and her tape player to cure the students.

videos.title: The Puppy
videos.overview: The Watterson children's long-awaited pet puppy turns out to be a turtle which hates them.

videos.title: The Recipe
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin discover the secret behind their classmate Anton's immortality.

videos.title: The Name
videos.overview: When Mom reveals that Gumball's real name is "Zach," Gumball adopts a cheesy, annoying persona to match the name. His family tries to make him remember the old Gumball, as this new Zach persona is progressively taking over Gumball's life and erasing his memories.

videos.title: The Extras
videos.overview: Skits about the random extra characters seen throughout the series.

videos.title: The Gripes
videos.overview: When Gumball and Darwin begin to complain about every little thing in their lives, the people of Elmore City mistakenly assumes charity cases and put together a benefit to raise money for them, leaving them having to fix the mix-up.

videos.title: The Vacation
videos.overview: While driving to a campground, Nicole tells a horror story, which slowly starts to come true as their car breaks down and a stranger comes to help them out.

videos.title: The Fraud
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin discover Principal Brown's diploma is fake, and Principal Brown is determined to keep their discovery a secret.

videos.title: The Void
videos.overview: When Gumball and Darwin investigate a missing classmate, they discover a far greater mystery... about Elmore.

videos.title: The Boss
videos.overview: Mr. Robinson has a stress attack and needs a  stuffing transfusion from his son Rocky the janitor. He won't take it unless Rocky gets a better job in life. Rocky gets one with Chanax, where he becomes a work drone. Gumball and Darwin now need to get Rocky's soul back from his boss in order to get him to surgery.

videos.title: The Move
videos.overview: Clayton, a compulsive liar tells Gumball and Darwin about his awesome martial arts move, and discover that he wasn't lying.

videos.title: The Law
videos.overview: Doughnut Cop shows Gumball and Darwin that the smallest misdemeanor can lead to a breakdown in law.

videos.title: The Allergy
videos.overview: Gumball needs to find a cure for Darwin's allergy before he sneezes Elmore off the map.

videos.title: The Mothers
videos.overview: It's Mother's Day and kids put their moms through a series of tests to determine who has the World's Greatest Mom.

videos.title: The Password
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin are shocked to discover that Anais is Dad's favorite child.

videos.title: The Procrastinators
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin spend the day doing other things instead of taking out the trash like their mother told them to do before she got back home.

videos.title: The Shell
videos.overview: Gumball inadvertently cracks open Penny's shell, and discovers who she really is inside...

videos.title: The Burden
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin are left in charge of the class pet hamster, Chris Morris, but they end up leaving it at school over the weekend.

videos.title: The Bros
videos.overview: Darwin becomes jealous of Gumball and Penny's new relationship and sets out to find information that will break them up.

videos.title: The Mirror
videos.overview: Gumball refuses to forward an e-mail purportedly sent by a ghost, against Darwin's advice. When a curse begins to take effect and their family is dragged into another dimension, Gumball and Darwin seek Carrie's help to save them.

videos.title: The Man
videos.overview: After Granny Jojo brings her new boyfriend to dinner at the Watterson household, Richard forbids her from seeing the boyfriend again.

videos.title: The Pizza
videos.overview: The Wattersons have had a bad day, but it turns out Larry has too and it's about to get worse... for everyone!

videos.title: The Lie
videos.overview: Noticing that everyone is in the doldrums of January, Gumball and Anais invent a new holiday to spark excitement.

videos.title: The Butterfly
videos.overview: When a Butterfly emerges from its chrysalis Gumball and Darwin want to release it. Miss Simian warns them about the butterfly effect. Gumball releases it anyways, and a domino effect causes chaos throughout the city.

videos.title: The Question
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin try to figure out the meaning of life after coming down from a sugar rush.

videos.title: The Saint
videos.overview: After failing at making Alan lose his temper, Gumball and Darwin decide to adopt Alan's positive attitude.

videos.title: The Friend
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin help Anais make up an imaginary friend who turns out to be all too real.

videos.title: The Oracle
videos.overview: After discovering a prophetic painting depicting Gumball's naked run through the mall, he is determined to avoid that outcome.

videos.title: The Safety
videos.overview: Darwin becomes obsessed with safety after seeing a video in class.

videos.title: The Society
videos.overview: Gumball is convinced there is a Secret Society in school, and he wants in.

videos.title: The Spoiler
videos.overview: When Gumball and Darwin have to wait to see a movie, they must go an entire week without someone spoiling the plot.

videos.title: The Countdown
videos.overview: Miss Simian threatens to expel the boys if they are late for school, so they race a clock in order to arrive on time.

videos.title: The Nobody
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin investigate the disappearance  of the family's stuff only to find out some stranger is living in the house with them.

videos.title: The Downer
videos.overview: When Gumball's family tries to cheer him out of an inexplicable lousy mood, he wishes they would all disappear.

videos.title: The Egg
videos.overview: Nicole wants to show to Felicity that the Wattersons are a normal family, while her son, Billy, meets Anais.

videos.title: The Triangle
videos.overview: Gumball grows jealous of Darwin's new talent.

videos.title: The Money
videos.overview: The Wattersons become poor when Richard loses all their money.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Richard tries to find the kids before Nicole realizes they're gone.

videos.title: The Nemesis
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin discover that Rob, who once swore to wreak vengeance on them, has been trying to destroy them for some time… but his traps never work.

videos.title: The Crew
videos.overview: When Gumball and Darwin decide to join a crew, they are determined to prove their worth to senior citizens.

videos.title: The Others
videos.overview: After learning what grade Anais is in, Gumball and Darwin learn that there is a whole new world of students.

videos.title: The Signature
videos.overview: When Richard learns of Granny Jojo's plans to marry, he sets out to adopt Louie so he can forbid the wedding.

videos.title: The Check
videos.overview: Gumball, Darwin and Anais are delighted when Grandpa Louie gives them a check for $5000, but the family soon fights over how to spend it.

videos.title: The Pest
videos.overview: When they find Anais training herself for a brutal showdown, Gumball and Darwin realise that their sister is being pestered at school by an annoying kid: Billy. They try to teach her how to resolve the problem peacefully, but Billy has other ideas.

videos.title: The Sale
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin are crushed to learn that Mr. Robinson is selling his house and moving away, and when trying to make their final moments together last doesn't work, the duo decide to sabotage the sale.

videos.title: The Gift
videos.overview: After they receive an extravagant invitation to Masami's birthday party, Gumball and Darwin are anxious to find just the right gift for her. However, they're not the only ones: it turns out every kid in Elmore is competing to get Masami the perfect present.

videos.title: The Parking
videos.overview: When the Wattersons arrive at the mall for a day of shopping, they struggle to find a space in the parking lot. They search for a space everywhere -- using all their intelligence, cunning and trickery -- but as the day goes on, the desperate hunt for a space becomes more important than the trip to the mall itself.

videos.title: The Routine
videos.overview: Richard's trip to the store to find mayonnaise for the family's burger night turns into a Neverending Story-meets-Conan the Barbarian-style quest where he squares off against Tina Rex's father, Mr. Rex.

videos.title: The Upgrade
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin upgrade Bobert the robot – and discover that his new operating system is full of buggy and useless applications and is prone to crashing.

videos.title: The Comic
videos.overview: Sarah creates a comic of Gumball as a superhero named LaserHeart, prompting Gumball to act like one in real life.

videos.title: The Romantic
videos.overview: Fearing that she may be sick of him due to a missing emoji on her message to him, Gumball sends Penny on a romantic quest to rekindle their love, which turns into a disaster when Penny gets lost in the woods.

videos.title: The Uploads
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin get hooked on watching Elmore Stream (the show's version of YouTube) and viewers get a look at the different online videos the residents of Elmore have uploaded on the Internet.

videos.title: The Apprentice
videos.overview: Gumball tags along with Patrick Fitzgerald (Penny's father) as Patrick prepares to pitch plans for a new hospital to the CEO of Chanax -- and ends up roping him into a golf game with the CEO.

videos.title: The Hug
videos.overview: To prove to Darwin that he can be unpredictable, Gumball decides to hug the first person he sees -- an anthropomorphic hot dog -- and Gumball ends up in over his head when he and the Hot Dog Guy can't stop bumping into each other.

videos.title: The Wicked
videos.overview: After being framed for feeding coffee- and prune juice-laced nuts to the squirrels, Darwin tries to prove to Gumball that Mr. Robinson's wife, Margaret, is a good person underneath her destructive, sociopathic tendencies, but when Darwin sees just how evil Margaret is, the duo decide to catch her committing grand theft auto.

videos.title: The Traitor
videos.overview: When Alan allegedly ditches Gumball's dinner date with him, Gumball is desperate to track him down and make him pay for his betrayal, only to learn that Alan is taking his mother, Jessica, to the hospital for an organ transplant.

videos.title: The Origins (1)
videos.overview: In this, the first half-hour episode, a four-year-old Gumball becomes too much for young parents, Nicole and Richard, to handle, so they buy him a goldfish, but after the first six die from neglect, stupidity, and unfortunate incidents, Richard finds a special one in a shady red van who bonds with Gumball on a spiritual level. This gets put to the test when Darwin gets flushed down the toilet and must traverse a scary, new world to return home.

videos.title: The Origins (2)
videos.overview: In this, the first half-hour episode, a four-year-old Gumball becomes too much for young parents, Nicole and Richard, to handle, so they buy him a goldfish, but after the first six die from neglect, stupidity, and unfortunate incidents, Richard finds a special one in a shady red van who bonds with Gumball on a spiritual level. This gets put to the test when Darwin gets flushed down the toilet and must traverse a scary, new world to return home.

videos.title: The Girlfriend
videos.overview: After seeing Alan and Carmen bond during her lunchtime bullying, Jamie decides that she needs a sweetheart... and has her eyes on Darwin.

videos.title: The Advice
videos.overview: Mr. Small feels that he hasn't inspired the children of Elmore Junior High, so Gumball and Darwin try to lift his spirits... and end up causing chaos and putting most of the students (and faculty) in the school infirmary (and others in the hospital) after following Mr. Small's useless advice.

videos.title: The Signal
videos.overview: Gumball develops a strange stutter, and it makes him accidentally offend Darwin.

videos.title: The Parasite
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin read Anais' diary and discover her relationship with a new friend is one-sided.

videos.title: The Love
videos.overview: The people of Elmore search for the meaning of love.

videos.title: The Awkwardness
videos.overview: Gumball is walking in the same direction as Hot Dog Guy, and with each step it becomes increasingly awkward.

videos.title: The Nest
videos.overview: A neighbor disappears and the Wattersons investigate, but discover the culprit may be their Evil Turtle.

videos.title: The Points
videos.overview: In order for Tobias to let them use his points in a video game, Gumball and Darwin must do his chores for him.

videos.title: The Bus
videos.overview: Rocky convinces the kids that they do not have to go to school. However, unbeknownst to the kids, some adults are trying to teach them about skipping school.

videos.title: The Night
videos.overview: The Moon examines dreams and nightmares of Elmore residents.

videos.title: The Misunderstandings
videos.overview: On his way to a date with Penny, Gumball finds himself dealing with people at their most oblivious.

videos.title: The Roots
videos.overview: The family tries to make Darwin connect with his fish roots.

videos.title: The Blame
videos.overview: After Felicity bans video games in Elmore, Gumball and his friends try to have books banned instead.

videos.title: The Slap
videos.overview: Tobias offends Gumball when he doesn't slap him on the butt.

videos.title: The Detective
videos.overview: When Daisy goes missing, Anais suspects Gumball and Darwin.

videos.title: The Fury
videos.overview: A strange figure arrives and insults Nicole, but the kids are surprised when Nicole doesn't fight back.

videos.title: The Compilation
videos.overview: Odd internet clips are recalled by the people of Elmore.

videos.title: The Scam
videos.overview: Gumball scares the school into thinking a monster named Gargaroth is haunting the place, then recruits Carrie and Darwin (who has a crush on Carrie) as ghost exterminators in order to scam everyone in Elmore of their candy.

videos.title: The Disaster
videos.overview: Rob gets new powers through a remote control and tries to destroy Gumball's world.

videos.title: The Stories
videos.overview: Fed up with having to listen to Molly's long, tedious anecdotes, Gumball and Darwin try to teach her how to make them sound more exciting. When this doesn't work, they decide their only option is to give Molly a story worth telling.

videos.title: The Re-Run
videos.overview: In this sequel to last season's "The Disaster", Gumball travels back to the events of the previous episode to prevent Rob from ruining his life, but everything he does makes things worse.

videos.title: The Guy
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin are wary of Anais' new friend, Josh, making her question his motives as well.

videos.title: The Boredom
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin search for adventure during a walk around Elmore.

videos.title: The Vision
videos.overview: After finding a secret manifesto on Alan's memory stick, Gumball and Darwin decide to foil his plan for world domination.

videos.title: The Choices
videos.overview: Nicole reminisces about how she met Richard during a disastrous family dinner, and how things could have turned out for her if she had not.

videos.title: The Code
videos.overview: The family goes without wi-fi after Mr. Robinson changes the passcode, so Gumball tries to recover it.

videos.title: The Test
videos.overview: When he is labeled a "loser" in an online test, Gumball believes he must do the opposite of everything he would normally do. Meanwhile, Darwin and Sarah notice Tobias is stealing Gumball's life and role in the series in the form of a cheesy sitcom.

videos.title: The Slide
videos.overview: Rocky decides to stop living life online, and find love on a dating app, and Gumball and Darwin try to help him.

videos.title: The Loophole
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin give Bobert instructions so he will behave in a safe and responsible manner, but he applies his logic to their rules.

videos.title: The Potato
videos.overview: When Darwin has lunch with Idaho, he decides to stop eating potatoes in solidarity with his brotato, but he finds his obsession with his favorite food harder to kick than he ever imagined, so Gumball decides to help his friend curb his carb cravings.

videos.title: The Fuss
videos.overview: Nicole tries, and fails, to hide her disappointment when Richard and the kids fail to remember her special day. Richard has to figure out what special day he has actually forgotten and then make it a day to remember or else.

videos.title: The Copycats
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin are confused when they meet Chi Chi and Ribbit, a pair of siblings that copy everything they do and say. Then they find out this copycat family is making money online from imitating the Watterson family.

videos.title: The Outside
videos.overview: The family goes to visit Richard's dad. Based on his basic living standards and extended absence from Richard's life, they assume Frankie must have done a stretch in the slammer.

videos.title: The Vase
videos.overview: Sick of Granny Jojo's ugly gifts, Nicole encourages the kids to take matters into their own hands and "accidentally" break her latest hideous vase. But when Gumball, Darwin, and Anais try to destroy it, they discover it is more robust than it seems.

videos.title: The Matchmaker
videos.overview: Gumball enlists Carrie to help bring Darwin and Teri together, but when they can't make Darwin and Teri's love blossom naturally, they decide to make it happen supernaturally.

videos.title: The Box
videos.overview: The Wattersons receive an unmarked package in the mail. To distract themselves from the urge to open it they all take turns to imagine what it might contain.

videos.title: The Console
videos.overview: When Gumball is given a cursed video game console, Elmore becomes trapped inside a fantasy RPG world. Gumball, Darwin and Anais have to battle their way through town, unraveling the secrets of their new virtual reality.

videos.title: The Ollie
videos.overview: Gumball teaches Darwin everything he knows about the world of skateboarding.

videos.title: The Catfish
videos.overview: When Gumball and Darwin realize Grandpa Louie has no friends, they create one called Muriel, when Granny Jojo finds out Louie has been spending time online with another woman, Muriel not existing is not going to stop her from being destroyed.

videos.title: The Cycle
videos.overview: Gumball, Darwin and Anais discover that Mr. Wilson has been picking on Richard for most of his life; ever since he humiliated Richard with a high school prank. The kids try to work their dad through it, but when their efforts fail they realize that getting back at Mr. Wilson is the only way to break the cycle.

videos.title: The Stars
videos.overview: When Richard gives Larry’s hairdresser a bad review for saying he’s bald, he gets offered a free haircut. This inspires Gumball and Darwin to go on a reviewing spree across town, forcing Larry to give them stuff with the threat of a bad review. But, just because the customer is always right doesn’t mean that what they’re doing isn’t wrong.

videos.title: The Grades
videos.overview: When a failed test grade brings down Gumball’s grade point average, he is forced to return to kindergarten.

videos.title: The Diet
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin find out why Richard's diet wasn't working, and after they help him lose weight, he becomes more obnoxious.

videos.title: The Ex
videos.overview: When Gumball learns that his nemesis, Rob, has found a new nemesis, he tries to sabotage Rob's new "enemy-ship", much to the frustration of Penny.

videos.title: The Sorcerer
videos.overview: Gumball refuses to accept he is the only kid at school that does not have special powers. He convinces Mrs. Jötunheim, Hector's mom, to take him on as her apprentice but she soon learns leaving Gumball unsupervised around magic is a big mistake.

videos.title: The Menu
videos.overview: The prize jewel on the Secret Joyful Burger menu is a mysterious burger, but to order it you need to know its name. When Larry refuses to tell Richard, Gumball, and Darwin what it is called, they go to super-sized lengths to discover it.

videos.title: The Uncle
videos.overview: When Gumball finds out that Ocho has an uncle named Mario, he becomes desperate to meet him.

videos.title: The Weirdo
videos.overview: When they see the school bullies making fun of Sussie, Gumball and Darwin decide to try and help her act less weird. They carefully observe her behavior and decide that the only thing they have to change is absolutely everything.

videos.title: The Heist
videos.overview: Richard discovers that going into a bank whilst wearing a motorcycle helmet can lead to trouble.

videos.title: The Singing
videos.overview: Join the citizens of Elmore for a song and dance spectacular that will have people covering their ears with joy.

videos.title: The Best
videos.overview: No matter what Gumball does, Carmen thinks she knows better; when Gumball attempts to gain the moral high ground, but fails, his only option left is to bring Carmen down to his level.

videos.title: The Worst
videos.overview: The Wattersons compete over who has the worst life.

videos.title: The Deal
videos.overview: Richard goes on strike to prove that his work around the house is under appreciated by Nicole.

videos.title: The Petals
videos.overview: When Leslie's petals begin falling off, he feels like his good looks are fading, so Gumball and Darwin use everything they know about style and beauty to try and help him.

videos.title: The Puppets
videos.overview: Darwin is delighted when they discover their old childhood toys, but soon realizes that some things are best left in the past.

videos.title: The Nuisance
videos.overview: The Wattersons fear the worst when they are summoned to a Town Hall meeting, but are surprised when they're offered a new house - until they discover it's in a different state.

videos.title: The Line
videos.overview: The Wattersons will do whatever it takes to get into the first screening of the latest Stellar Odyssey sequel.

videos.title: The List
videos.overview: When the kids find out that Mom's life hasn't panned out as she'd hoped, they start taking on her chores, but they accidentally grab her bucket list instead of her to-do list.

videos.title: The News
videos.overview: From police chases to the inside scoop on Daisy the Donkey, Channel 6 Elmore News has all the top local stories. Experienced newscaster Kip Schlezinger brings the latest news, sports and weather, even when there is absolutely nothing to report.

videos.title: The Rival
videos.overview: When Anais is a newborn baby, Gumball and Darwin become jealous of their new sibling, and spark a baby war.

videos.title: The Lady
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin find out that Dad has been dressing as a woman to make friends.

videos.title: The Sucker
videos.overview: Darwin ends up in detention with Julius, who decides to make Darwin his new target. However, it backfires when Darwin ruins his life.

videos.title: The Vegging
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin want to veg out all day, but their plans go awry and they have to save the rest of the family.

videos.title: The One
videos.overview: Tobias tries to be Gumball’s best friend.

videos.title: The Father
videos.overview: The kids try to help Richard bond with Frankie.

videos.title: The Cringe
videos.overview: Gumball and Hot Dog Guy discover why they're so awkward with each other.

videos.title: The Cage
videos.overview: The kids convince Mr. Corneille to become a cage fighter and set up a fight against a fearsome Russian fighter.

videos.title: The Faith
videos.overview: Alan has lost faith in humanity and turns the world black and white. Gumball must get over his hatred of Alan to bring the color back by singing.

videos.title: The Candidate
videos.overview: A group of kids get locked in the school after their parents have a charity gala. They appoint Gumball as leader to get them out but it leads to chaos.

videos.title: The Anybody
videos.overview: When Clayton shapeshifts into Gumball to take his detention, he starts framing others for misdemeanors so Gumball and Darwin must track Clayton down to stop him.

videos.title: The Pact
videos.overview: Gumball and Principal Brown make a pact to tell each other what problems their girlfriends have.

videos.title: The Neighbor
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin try to find out the name of their neighbor, Antlers Guy, but accidentally blow his witness protection cover.

videos.title: The Shippening
videos.overview: Sarah finds a notebook from the Awesome Store which magically makes what she draws happen. Unfortunately, she draws bizarre love stories throughout Elmore.

videos.title: The Brain
videos.overview: The Wattersons have to stop doing stupid things in order to prevent Anais from falling into a coma from facepalming too much.

videos.title: The Parents
videos.overview: Nicole and her parents reconnect after a long forced absence.

videos.title: The Founder
videos.overview: Richard creates chaos in the Chanax building when he is mistaken for the long lost CEO. Nicole and a disgruntled employee must save everyone from Richard's dangerous ideas.

videos.title: The Schooling
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin take on Larry's jobs for 5 minutes and realize how bad it is.

videos.title: The Intelligence
videos.overview: Technology reaches human intelligence then becomes dysfunctional as it picks up human flaws.

videos.title: The Potion
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin use a magic potion to shrink Hector.

videos.title: The Spinoffs
videos.overview: Rob creates a variety of spinoff Elmore shows and formats to replace Gumball.

videos.title: The Transformation
videos.overview: Gumball is asked to settle a dispute between Penny and her family.

videos.title: The Understanding
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin get into trouble misunderstanding a new kid in school.

videos.title: The Ad
videos.overview: The Wattersons are forced to rent their house to a pair of elderly fainting goats.

videos.title: The Ghouls
videos.overview: Halloween isn't what it used to be. Can Gumball and Darwin help the ghouls get their scare back?

videos.title: The Stink
videos.overview: Mr. Small goes feral after Gumball and Darwin expose his hypocrisy.

videos.title: The Awareness
videos.overview: Gumball decides to engross himself in plant culture to appease Leslie after making an offensive comment.

videos.title: The Slip
videos.overview: Richard misses a package and is forced into an escalating feud with the delivery guy.

videos.title: The Drama
videos.overview: Gumball tries to protect Darwin from his unsuitable undead girlfriend Carrie.

videos.title: The Buddy
videos.overview: Anais and Jamie form an unlikely partnership when they're accused of a crime they didn't commit.

videos.title: The Possession
videos.overview: Richard becomes supernaturally attached to his old refrigerator.

videos.title: The Master
videos.overview: The Wattersons play a fantasy role-playing board game to resolve their differences.

videos.title: The Silence
videos.overview: Have Gumball and Darwin finally run out of things to say to each other?

videos.title: The Future
videos.overview: Banana Joe's Mom can predict the future, but she can't predict her own disappearance.

videos.title: The Wish
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin believe they've turned Miss Simian into a neck-cushion.

videos.title: The Factory
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin save the day at the Rainbow Factory.

videos.title: The Agent
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin's clothes go missing after a swimming lesson; when Gumball is forced to wear a tuxedo from the lost and found office, he believes it makes him look like a certain dapper British secret agent.

videos.title: The Web
videos.overview: Gumball and Darwin realize that the adult residents of Elmore are dangerously naive when it comes to being safe online, and in fact are in serious need of the boys' help with even the simplest of tasks.

videos.title: The Mess
videos.overview: After staying up all night, the boys baby-sit Penny's little sister and manage to lose her in the blink of an eye.

videos.title: The Heart
videos.overview: Mr. Robinson tries and repeatedly fails to win back Gumball and Darwin's friendship.

videos.title: The Revolt
videos.overview: Darwin tries to highlight the plight of all the household objects he feels are being oppressed and maltreated by the uncaring residents of Elmore, then decides to lead those objects in a revolt against the townspeople.

videos.title: The Decisions
videos.overview: When everything goes wrong in Darwin's life, he begins to suspect that Gumball's bad influence might be to blame; Darwin decides to go elsewhere for guidance and finds a new mentor in Alan.

videos.title: The BFFs
videos.overview: When Gumball's old BFF Fuzzy turns up on his doorstep, Darwin struggles to accept that there was someone before him and fails to contain his jealousy.

videos.title: The Inquisition
videos.overview: The students of Elmore Junior High find their world turned upside down when the mysterious school superintendent comes to stamp out their cartoonish ways.
